Latin word

cupiditās

cupiditās, cupiditātis f.

noun, third declension: with the genitive of the thing or a gerund (cupiditās videndī)

desire, eagerness, longing

In this lexicon

  • desire

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 12.26.1: vel studiō potius et cupiditāte nōn dubitō; Traupman 151, 152, 156; Traupman 303
